description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three different models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across a set of linguistic categories labeled L4+, L3, L2, L1, T, R1, R2, R3, and R4+. The vertical axis represents the Shapley value, ranging from 0 to 80, while the horizontal axis displays the linguistic categories. Each category has three corresponding bars, one for each model, with the legend indicating the color associated with each model. The tallest bar is for chLSTM in the T category, reaching a Shapley value of approximately 80. The mBERT model shows relatively high values in the T category, around 60, while the XLM-R model peaks at approximately 55 in the same category. For most other categories, the Shapley values are much lower, with the chLSTM model generally having the highest values in the L1, R1, and R4+ categories, and the mBERT model showing higher values in L4+, L2, and R2. The XLM-R model consistently has the lowest or very low values across all categories except for T. The bars are grouped by category, with each group containing one bar for each model, and the categories are arranged in a specific order along the horizontal axis.
